visual.description: Split screen: left side shows '$3,000/month' cash stack illustration. Right side splits vertically — top: Zurich skyline silhouette with floating prices (rent $2,800, groceries $600), bottom: Mexico City silhouette with lower prices (rent $400, groceries $150). Cash stack visually 'shrinks' in Zurich (scale 1.0→0.3) and 'grows' in Mexico City (scale 1.0→2.5). Then transition to 'Purchasing Power Parity' title card. Animated basket of ~3,000 goods. Then PPP salary bar chart: LUX ($94,447), ISL ($89,947), CHE ($87,468), USA ($82,933) top. GRC ($32,257), MEX ($20,433) bottom.

notes: Phase 1 — PPP explanation. Two visual beats: (1) the $3,000 split screen showing local price differences, (2) PPP salary bar chart. NO Big Mac references. PPP basket animation is a new visual element. Bar chart shows top 4 + bottom 2 for contrast. Green for top earners, red for bottom.
